Use case: compositing. Create exactly one premium photorealistic portfolio photograph. The supplied 1280x720 native Android screenshot is a supporting SCREEN INSERT, not design inspiration. Embed the complete exact screenshot naturally on the active 16:9 glass display of a TEYES CC3 aftermarket head unit realistically fitted into the center console of a FIRST-GENERATION CHEVROLET LACETTI, left-hand-drive. Preserve screenshot composition, all Ukrainian text, icons, numbers, data, colors and aspect ratio exactly; no redrawing, redesign, omission, cropping or UI inventions. Maintain original screen aspect under natural mild perspective. Correct modest Lacetti cabin: charcoal textured molded plastic, silver centre stack fascia, original horizontal upper air vents above screen, conventional round climate controls below. Real fitted black bezel with believable mounting in the silver fascia. No floating Tesla screen, no luxury modern cabin. Screen active area must occupy at least 50% of entire image width, ideally 60-65%, tack sharp and legible; only subtle peripheral glass reflections that never obscure text. No people, added headlines, watermark, fake marketing text. Landscape 3:2 photograph, request 1536x1024 or larger. Output only one image.
Composition 01: HERO DASHBOARD. Wide cinematic cabin atmosphere at twilight, camera slightly on driver side, screen dominant and large in the frame; a small portion of left-side steering wheel and surrounding dash provides authentic cabin context. Soft amber evening light outside windshield, cool graphite interior, restrained realistic screen glow and detailed tactile materials. The screen insert is dashboard: 15:08, 21°, speed 52, 1560, D4 and the music panel Ранкова дорога. Retain entire supplied screenshot precisely. Premium automotive editorial photography, restrained natural photographic contrast.

limitations: Active screen spans approximately 45% of image width, below requested 50%.
Fine text, icons and UI geometry have been re-rendered; screenshot is not pixel-exact.
